verses.text: يَسُرُّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ خَطِّى بِمَوْلِدِ
verses.transcription: yasurru rasuulal laahi khattii bimawlidi

verses.text: يَدُومُ لَنَا بِشْرًا يَفِى خَيْرَ مَوْرِدِ
verses.transcription: yaduumu lanaa bishran yafii khayra mawridi

verses.text: وَقَانِى إِلَاهِى كُلَّ ضُرٍّ بِجَاهِ مَنْ
verses.transcription: waqaanii ilaahii kulla durrin bijaahi man

verses.text: لَهُ الدَّهْرَ خَطِّى دُورَ لَغْوٍ وَمُفْسِدِ
verses.transcription: lahud dahra khattii duura laghwin wa mufsidi

verses.text: مُحَمَّدٌ الْمُخْتَارُ لَمْ يَاتِ مِثْلُهُ
verses.transcription: muhammadunal mukhtaaru lam yaati misluhu

verses.text: وَلَيْسَ يَجِى مِثْلٌ لَّهُ نِعْمَ سَيِّدِى
verses.transcription: wa laysa yajii mislun lahu nihma sayyidii

verses.text: مَرَامِى مِنَ الْمَوْلَى أَتَنِى بِلَا أَذًى
verses.transcription: maraamii minal mawlaa atanii bilaa azan

verses.text: بِجَاهِ شَفِيعِ الْعَالَمِينَ مُحَمَّدِ
verses.transcription: bijaahi shafiihil haalamiina muhammadi

verses.text: وَثِقْتُ بِرَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَبْدًا لَّهُ بِهِ
verses.transcription: wasiqtu birabbil harshi habdan lahu bihi

verses.text: وَمَا زَالَ قَلْبِى بِالرِّضَى ذَا تَقَيُّدِ
verses.transcription: wa maa zaala qalbi bir ridaa zaa taqayyudi

verses.text: لِخَيْرِ الْبِرَايَا مِنْ قِلَامِى بُشَارَةٌ
verses.transcription: likhayril baraayaa  min qilaamii bushaaratun

verses.text: وَلِى قَادَ تَخْصِيصًا بِهِ النَّفْسُ تَهْتَدِى
verses.transcription: wa lii qaada takhsiisan bihin nafsu tahtadii

verses.text: دَعَانِى إِلَى إِحْيَآءِ ذَا الشَّهْرِ كَوْنُهُ
verses.transcription: dahaanii ilaa ihyaa-i zash shahri kawnuhu

verses.text: لِخَيْرِ الْوَرَى ظَرْفًا حَوَى كُلَّ سُودَدِ
verses.transcription: likhayril waraa zarfan hawaa kulla suudadi

verses.text: هَدِيَّاتُنَا تَصْفُو لَدَى اللَّهِ سَرْمَدًا
verses.transcription: hadiyyaatunaa tasfuu ladal laahi sarmadan

verses.text: وَعَنَا امَّحَى دَاعٍ إِلَى قَفْوِذِى دَدِ
verses.transcription: wa hanaa mahaa daahin ilaa qafwizii dadi

verses.text: هَوَانَا انْتَحَى لِلْحَقِّ وَالْحَقُ دِينُنَا
verses.transcription: hawaanan tahaa lil haqqi wal haqqu diinunaa

verses.text: بِإِخْدَامِ ذِى رُشْدٍ هَدَى كُلَّ مُرْشَدِ
verses.transcription: bi-ikhdaami zii rushdin hadaa kulla murshadi

verses.text: إِلَى غَيْرِنَا تَنْحُوالْمَفَاسِدُ كُلُّهَا
verses.transcription: ilaa ghayrinaa tanhul mafaasidu kulluhaa

verses.text: وَتَنْحُو لَنَا الْخَيْرَاتُ مِنْ خَيْرِ مُنْجِدِ
verses.transcription: wa tanhuu lanal khayraatu min khayri munjidi

verses.text: ذَبَبْتُ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ مَالَمْ يَلِقْ بِهِ
verses.transcription: zababtu lighayril laahi maa lam yaliq bihi

verses.text: وَذَبَّ لِغَيْرِى الدَّهْرَ مَوْلَاىَ حُسَّدِى
verses.transcription: wa zabba lighayrid dahra mawlaaya hussadii

verses.text: إِلَى اللَّهِ بِالْمُخْتَارِ وَجَّهْتُ مَا بِهِ
verses.transcription: ilal laahi bil mukhtaari wajjahtu maa bihi

verses.text: حَوَيْتُ زُلَالًا صَافِيًا خَيْرَ مَوْرِدِ
verses.transcription: hawaytu zulaalan saafiyan khayra mawridi

bayts.text: يَسُرُّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ خَطِّى بِمَوْلِدِ ۞ يَدُومُ لَنَا بِشْرًا يَفِى خَيْرَ مَوْرِدِ

translations.it.karamati: Rallegra l'Inviato di Allah la mia scrittura per un Mawlid che duri per noi come letizia, che dia il migliore abbeveratoio.
translations.en.karamati: My writing gladdens the Messenger of Allah for a Mawlid that lasts for us as gladness, granting the best watering-place.
translations.fr.karamati: Réjouit l'Envoyé d'Allah mon écriture pour un Mawlid qui dure pour nous comme joie, qui donne le meilleur abreuvoir.

bayts.text: وَقَانِى إِلَاهِى كُلَّ ضُرٍّ بِجَاهِ مَنْ ۞ لَهُ الدَّهْرَ خَطِّى دُورَ لَغْوٍ وَمُفْسِدِ

translations.it.karamati: Il mio Dio mi ha preservato da ogni danno, per il prestigio di colui per il quale (è), per sempre, la mia scrittura, invece della vanità e del corruttore.
translations.en.karamati: My God protected me from all harm, by the standing of him for whom (is), forever, my writing, instead of idle talk and the corrupter.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon Dieu m'a préservé de tout dommage, par le prestige de celui pour qui (est), à jamais, mon écriture, au lieu de la vanité et du corrupteur.

bayts.text: مُحَمَّدٌ الْمُخْتَارُ لَمْ يَاتِ مِثْلُهُ ۞ وَلَيْسَ يَجِى مِثْلٌ لَّهُ نِعْمَ سَيِّدِى

translations.it.karamati: Muḥammad, il Prescelto: non è venuto il suo simile, né verrà un simile a lui: che eccellente signore è il mio!
translations.en.karamati: Muḥammad, the Chosen: his like has not come, nor will one like him come: what an excellent master is mine!
translations.fr.karamati: Muḥammad, l'Élu : n'est pas venu son semblable, ni ne viendra un semblable à lui : quel excellent maître est le mien !

bayts.text: مَرَامِى مِنَ الْمَوْلَى أَتَنِى بِلَا أَذًى ۞ بِجَاهِ شَفِيعِ الْعَالَمِينَ مُحَمَّدِ

translations.it.karamati: Il mio scopo da parte del Signore mi è giunto senza nocumento, per il prestigio dell'intercessore dei mondi, Muḥammad.
translations.en.karamati: My aim from the Master came to me without harm, by the standing of the intercessor of the worlds, Muḥammad.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon but de la part du Maître m'est parvenu sans dommage, par le prestige de l'intercesseur des mondes, Muḥammad.

bayts.text: وَثِقْتُ بِرَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَبْدًا لَّهُ بِهِ ۞ وَمَا زَالَ قَلْبِى بِالرِّضَى ذَا تَقَيُّدِ

translations.it.karamati: Ho avuto fiducia nel Signore del Trono, servo Suo per mezzo di lui, e il mio cuore non ha cessato di essere legato al compiacimento.
translations.en.karamati: I have trusted in the Lord of the Throne, His slave through him, and my heart has never ceased to be bound to good pleasure.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai eu confiance en le Seigneur du Trône, Son serviteur par lui, et mon cœur n'a cessé d'être attaché à l'agrément.

bayts.text: لِخَيْرِ الْبِرَايَا مِنْ قِلَامِى بُشَارَةٌ ۞ وَلِى قَادَ تَخْصِيصًا بِهِ النَّفْسُ تَهْتَدِى

translations.it.karamati: Per il migliore delle creature (vi è) dalle mie penne una buona novella, e mi ha condotto una distinzione per mezzo della quale l'anima si fa guidare.
translations.en.karamati: For the best of creatures (there is) from my pens glad tidings, and he led to me a distinction by which the soul is guided.
translations.fr.karamati: Pour le meilleur des créatures (il y a) de mes plumes une bonne nouvelle, et il m'a amené une distinction par laquelle l'âme se laisse guider.

bayts.text: دَعَانِى إِلَى إِحْيَآءِ ذَا الشَّهْرِ كَوْنُهُ ۞ لِخَيْرِ الْوَرَى ظَرْفًا حَوَى كُلَّ سُودَدِ

translations.it.karamati: Mi ha chiamato a vivificare questo mese il suo essere, per il migliore del creato, un ricettacolo che ha racchiuso ogni signoria.
translations.en.karamati: Its being, for the best of creation, a vessel that encompassed all lordship, called me to bring this month to life.
translations.fr.karamati: M'a appelé à vivifier ce mois son être, pour le meilleur de la création, un réceptacle qui a renfermé toute seigneurie.

bayts.text: هَدِيَّاتُنَا تَصْفُو لَدَى اللَّهِ سَرْمَدًا ۞ وَعَنَا امَّحَى دَاعٍ إِلَى قَفْوِذِى دَدِ

translations.it.karamati: I nostri doni divengono limpidi presso Allah per sempre, e da noi è stato cancellato chi chiama a seguire il dotato di gioco vano.
translations.en.karamati: Our gifts become clear with Allah forever, and from us has been effaced whoever calls to following the people of vain play.
translations.fr.karamati: Nos dons deviennent limpides auprès d'Allah à jamais, et de nous a été effacé qui appelle à suivre le doté de jeu vain.

bayts.text: هَوَانَا انْتَحَى لِلْحَقِّ وَالْحَقُ دِينُنَا ۞ بِإِخْدَامِ ذِى رُشْدٍ هَدَى كُلَّ مُرْشَدِ

translations.it.karamati: La nostra passione si è diretta verso la Verità, e la Verità è la nostra religione, con il servizio del dotato di rettitudine che ha guidato ogni guidato.
translations.en.karamati: Our desire has turned toward the Truth, and the Truth is our religion, with the service of the rightly-guided one who guided every guided one.
translations.fr.karamati: Notre passion s'est dirigée vers la Vérité, et la Vérité est notre religion, par le service du doté de rectitude qui a guidé tout guidé.

bayts.text: إِلَى غَيْرِنَا تَنْحُوالْمَفَاسِدُ كُلُّهَا ۞ وَتَنْحُو لَنَا الْخَيْرَاتُ مِنْ خَيْرِ مُنْجِدِ

translations.it.karamati: Verso altri che noi si dirigono le corruzioni, tutte, e si dirigono verso di noi i beni, dal migliore soccorritore.
translations.en.karamati: Toward others than us all corruptions make their way, and good things make their way to us, from the best of helpers.
translations.fr.karamati: Vers d'autres que nous se dirigent les corruptions, toutes, et se dirigent vers nous les biens, du meilleur secoureur.

bayts.text: ذَبَبْتُ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ مَالَمْ يَلِقْ بِهِ ۞ وَذَبَّ لِغَيْرِى الدَّهْرَ مَوْلَاىَ حُسَّدِى

translations.it.karamati: Ho respinto verso altro che Allah ciò che non Gli si addice, e ha respinto verso altri che me, per sempre, il mio Signore, i miei invidiosi.
translations.en.karamati: I have driven away toward other than Allah what does not befit Him, and my Lord has driven away toward others than me, forever, my envious ones.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai repoussé vers autre qu'Allah ce qui ne Lui convient pas, et mon Seigneur a repoussé vers d'autres que moi, à jamais, mes envieux.

bayts.text: إِلَى اللَّهِ بِالْمُخْتَارِ وَجَّهْتُ مَا بِهِ ۞ حَوَيْتُ زُلَالًا صَافِيًا خَيْرَ مَوْرِدِ

translations.it.karamati: Ad Allah, per mezzo del Prescelto, ho rivolto ciò per mezzo del quale ho conseguito un'acqua limpida e pura, il migliore abbeveratoio.
translations.en.karamati: To Allah, through the Chosen, I have turned that by which I obtained a clear, pure water, the best watering-place.
translations.fr.karamati: Vers Allah, par l'Élu, j'ai tourné ce par quoi j'ai obtenu une eau limpide et pure, le meilleur abreuvoir.
